examples.label: SaaS social-proof band with three rated customer quotes
examples.source:
Ninety days in

<.component component_name="chelekom-h2" site="Global" font_weight="font-semibold" class="mt-3 tracking-tight"> 4,200 operations teams plan their week in Northwind <.component component_name="chelekom-p" site="Global" size="large" class="mt-4 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400"> We asked customers what actually changed after they switched. These three answers came back the most.
<.component component_name="chelekom-grid" site="Global" id="northwind-proof-grid" cols="one" gap="extra_large" class="mt-14 items-start md:grid-cols-3"> <.component component_name="chelekom-blockquote" site="Global" id="northwind-proof-onboarding" size="extra_large" padding="large" rounded="large" space="medium" blockquote_class="p-0! leading-7"> Customer onboarding took eleven days and four handoffs. We rebuilt the whole flow in a single sprint and it now finishes the same afternoon. <:caption> <.component component_name="chelekom-rating" site="Global" id="northwind-proof-onboarding-rating" select={5} size="medium" /> <:caption> Nadia Kessler VP Customer Success, Loop Freight <.component component_name="chelekom-blockquote" site="Global" id="northwind-proof-forecast" size="extra_large" padding="large" rounded="large" space="medium" blockquote_class="p-0! leading-7"> The forecast used to live in one spreadsheet that one person understood. Now every regional lead owns their own numbers and the roll-up is correct before I get in. <:caption> <.component component_name="chelekom-rating" site="Global" id="northwind-proof-forecast-rating" select={5} size="medium" /> <:caption> Marta Oyelaran Director of Revenue Operations, Vantage Cold Chain <.component component_name="chelekom-blockquote" site="Global" id="northwind-proof-support" size="extra_large" padding="large" rounded="large" space="medium" blockquote_class="p-0! leading-7"> Support and product finally read the same board. Escalations that used to sit for a week get picked up the same day, and nobody chases anybody in chat any more. <:caption> <.component component_name="chelekom-rating" site="Global" id="northwind-proof-support-rating" select={5} size="medium" /> <:caption> Ingrid Sollberger Head of Support, Marrow Bank

examples.label: Agency case-study pull quote breaking a column of body copy
examples.source:
Case study — Ferrous Rail

<.component component_name="chelekom-h3" site="Global" font_weight="font-semibold" class="mt-3 tracking-tight"> Rebuilding a booking flow that forty thousand people use before breakfast <.component component_name="chelekom-p" site="Global" size="large" class="mt-6 text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300"> Ferrous Rail came to us with a checkout that worked and nobody liked. Seven screens, two of them asking for the same date, and a payment step that timed out on the platform Wi-Fi at exactly the moment people needed it most. <.component component_name="chelekom-p" site="Global" size="large" class="mt-4 text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300"> We spent the first three weeks not designing anything. We rode the 07:14 out of Leeds with a stopwatch and watched two hundred people try to buy a ticket standing up, one-handed, with a coffee. <.component component_name="chelekom-blockquote" site="Global" id="ferrous-pull-quote" variant="outline" color="primary" border="large" size="extra_large" padding="large" rounded="none" space="medium" class="my-10" blockquote_class="p-0! text-xl leading-9 sm:text-2xl"> They came back with a stopwatch and a commute, not a mood board. Three screens went in the bin and our completion rate moved nineteen points in a fortnight. <:caption position="left"> Priya Raghunathan Head of Digital, Ferrous Rail <.component component_name="chelekom-p" site="Global" size="large" class="mt-4 text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300"> The rebuilt flow is three screens and holds its state offline, so a dropped signal in a tunnel no longer costs a sale. It shipped in eleven weeks and has not been touched since, which is the outcome we are proudest of.

examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-h2" site="Global" font_weight="font-semibold" class="tracking-tight"> Tidemark 3.0 shipped last week <.component component_name="chelekom-p" site="Global" size="large" class="mt-4 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400"> A full rewrite of the sync engine, a new offline mode, and a settings screen that finally fits on one page. Here is what the reviewers made of it.
<.component component_name="chelekom-grid" site="Global" id="tidemark-press-grid" cols="one" gap="extra_large" class="mt-12 items-start md:grid-cols-2"> <.component component_name="chelekom-blockquote" site="Global" id="tidemark-press-fieldnotes" variant="bordered" color="silver" full_border={true} border="small" size="extra_large" padding="large" rounded="large" space="medium" blockquote_class="p-0! leading-7"> The rare rewrite that makes an app smaller and faster at the same time. Sync finished before we could put the phone down, and the offline mode is the first one we have tested that does not lose an edit. <:caption> <.component component_name="chelekom-badge" site="Global" id="tidemark-press-fieldnotes-badge" variant="default" color="dark" size="small" rounded="full"> Field Notes Weekly <:caption> Camille Duarte Senior Editor <.component component_name="chelekom-blockquote" site="Global" id="tidemark-press-signalcast" variant="bordered" color="silver" full_border={true} border="small" size="extra_large" padding="large" rounded="large" space="medium" blockquote_class="p-0! leading-7"> Version two asked you to learn it. Version three just gets out of the way. We handed it to four people who had never seen the app and none of them opened the help page. <:caption> <.component component_name="chelekom-badge" site="Global" id="tidemark-press-signalcast-badge" variant="default" color="dark" size="small" rounded="full"> Signalcast Review <:caption> Tobias Lindqvist Mobile Correspondent
